purpose: Replace repeated inclusive 45x45 binary-mask support scans with exact owned occupancy summaries and constant-time summed-area queries in the optional camera tracker.

contract.math: Retain finite/strict margin admission, positive-coordinate truncation and the exact inclusive 22-pixel square. Empty/all-zero masks admit interior support; full masks reject. Mixed masks use a zero-bordered u32 summed-area table; query equality uses bounded integer sums. Mask labels, shape and clock validation retain ordering and reject before observable tracker mutation.
contract.ownership: Public tracker/report/WASM APIs, gray copies and explicit JS mask/image readbacks stay unchanged. Derived mask summaries are CPU-owned and independent of caller storage. At most two (321*321)*4 tables are live, 824328 logical prefix bytes; this excludes other tracker inputs and is not an RSS guarantee. No core/GPU/native accuracy-gate or dependency change.
contract.verification: Check every new predicate against the frozen brute-force square with finite/fractional/border controls, masks and dimensions. Preserve parent native tests/executable and baseline WASM, compare full public JSON reports in two balanced parent/candidate benchmark surveys, and require browser parent/candidate WASM report parity plus all existing actual WASM/model controls. Keep adverse timings; no hardware or speed claim without measured evidence.
contract.preservation: Preserve all prior camera/renderer files, 493 scientific JSON, 42 frozen native artifacts, room/reference outputs, shared cache, resolved lock and shared raw WASM. Compile only the small optional web feature in an isolated E: target, offline with installed toolchains. No sensor, SDK/model or toolchain acquisition.

resources.strategy: Fresh isolated Cargo target; no hardlinks to shared compiler outputs. Hash-check old artifacts and vendor hardlinks. Preserve all failures and executable versions. Retry complete storage snapshots up to three times only for vanished entries inside the owned live Cargo target.
resources.asset_download_scope: Zero new local assets; up to 40MiB of public verification streams without persisted vendor payloads.

benchmark.comparison: All report fields/serialized floats must match exactly. Publish every timing row and both survey ratios, including adverse or inconclusive results; make no physical-phone or GPU performance claim.

remaining_80_percent: Canonical measured calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying physical Linux hardware and integrated operational acceptance remain open.
